name: Doc Viewer
description: Token-protected markdown document viewer with themed templates, Pele diagrams, and HTML/PDF export. Adds the share_doc agent tool and the /plugin/doc-viewer/v/<token> endpoints.
author: Evonic

variables.name: ENABLED
variables.label: Enabled
variables.description: Kill switch. When disabled, share_doc and all viewer endpoints fail closed.

variables.name: PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.label: Public Base URL
variables.description: Externally reachable origin for viewer URLs, without trailing slash. Falls back to EVONIC_PUBLIC_URL, then http://127.0.0.1:8080.

variables.name: TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
variables.label: Token TTL (seconds)
variables.description: Lifetime of a viewer link. Default 7 days. Links are multi-use until expiry or revocation.

variables.name: DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
variables.label: Default template
variables.description: Template used when none is specified: paper, course-dark, or explainer.

variables.name: PDF_ENGINE
variables.label: PDF engine
variables.description: weasyprint (default) or chromium. Chromium is also used as automatic fallback when WeasyPrint fails.
